text: This clip shows how the owner orders materials from a vendor.
The owner starts a new purchase order and picks the vendor, Keystone Sign Supply. Then they add the materials: wrap film and overlaminate, three hundred feet of each, at the vendor's price.
The order downloads as a PDF. The owner attaches it to their own email and sends it to the vendor.
A few days later the rolls arrive. The owner opens the order and marks the whole order received in one step.
Back on the materials list, what you pay for the film and laminate now matches the prices on that order. No shelf counts to keep up.
